title: THE STONE YARD · HEAVY LAPS
why: GREEN on a big sleep, so today is the heavy day: the 60 lb bell and the 45s, low reps, slow lowering, a quarter mile out of every lap. First heavy-slow day since 09-17.

blocks.title: WARM-UP · 6 MIN · ONE PASS
blocks.meta: Moves Method Day A · spine / hams / hips / wrists

items.name: Jefferson curl ×6
items.detail: bodyweight, roll down one segment at a time

blocks.title: THE STONE YARD · AMRAP 26:00
blocks.meta: AMRAP 26:00 · 6 stations + 1 run leg per lap · target 4 LAPS · 60 lb bell, 2×45, 35
blocks.format: One clock, 26:00. Work the six stations in order, then the run leg, then start the next lap. Score = laps finished (a partial lap counts by station). Log laps, slowest station and RPE.
blocks.workRest: RUN LEG after station 6, every lap: 0.25 mi @ 8.5 mph flat. Lap 4 and beyond: 9.0.

items.name: 1 · Ground-to-shoulder 60 lb ×5/side
items.detail: WILDCARD · two hands on the horn, hike it from the floor and lap it onto one shoulder, back to the floor, alternate

items.name: 3 · Power shrug 2×45 ×12
items.detail: bells at the sides, small leg drive, shrug hard, 1-count hold at the top

items.name: 4 · One-arm push press 60 lb ×4/side
items.detail: rack it once per side, leg drive, 3 counts down

items.name: 5 · Shouldered split squat 60 lb ×6/side
items.detail: bell sitting on the shoulder of the back leg, back knee kisses the floor

items.name: 6 · Weighted sit-up 35 lb ×12
items.detail: bell at the chest, punch it up at the top

blocks.noteGreen: Green (today): 4 laps inside 26:00. Stretch: lap 5 through the push press.
blocks.noteYellow: Yellow: 3 laps, split squat with the 35, run legs at 8.0.

blocks.title: MIDLINE CLOSE · 3 ROUNDS
blocks.meta: 3 ROUNDS · windmill + hand walkout + bear-hold shoulder tap · straight through

items.name: Hand walkout ×8
items.detail: walk the hands out past the shoulders, hips do not sag, walk back

items.name: Bear-hold shoulder tap ×20
items.detail: knees an inch off the floor, hips do not turn
